name: SFX
job_description:
Mix and Master Voice Over, - We will provide raw voice overs, you need to mix and master it so that it the wavelengths are the same throughout - no audio peaking, And so that the voice sounds natural and clean

SFX - you will be in charge in adding life and characteristics to the video, you will get an mp4 of the video with no sound and an mp3 with the Voiceover you mixed and mastered, (you will also get an mp4 with the VO in place so that you can match the timings correctly), you will add sfx to enhance and give life to the video, everything that happens in the video should be portrayed to us with sound, it shouldnt be over the top or exaggerated, but there to enhance our experience subsconciously as we listen to the video. THIS IS THE MAKE OR BREAK OF THE VIDEO

Music - as we do 2-3 minute videos, you are in charge of having 2-3 song switches throughout the video, maybe more if the occasion asks for it, the music should lead us through the vidoe and guide the viewer towards what we want to feel, if we are pushing for an AHA moment, the viewer should feel that with the music, if were having a crazy bullish change the viewer should feel the dramatic music, the music is what awakens the viewers feelings throughout the video

Turnaround - turnaround times should be quick, usually you get a video by 6pm EST, sometimes later, you most likely will have to give us the new version by tommorow, SFX turnarond times are usually same day
